body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2010') -- <Visual News> Samsung Electronics unveiled its new ultra-compact LED pico projector during CES 2010. Equipped with a built-in battery supporting up to 2 hours, the Samsung LED pico projector features 30 ANSI lumen and WVGA(800*480) resolution.
< AVING Las Vegas team is on-site bringing readers the latest product CES2010 from the show floor, covering the press conferences >
